description: Service-Port examples: guard, policy, observe (4 files, Live at Port level — the Ports are real even though the components export nothing concrete) and gateway (1 file, proposed-interface guarded). Each example defines its own implementation of the real Port; the gateway example composes real parts (CapabilityRegistry + AuthorizerInterface) to show the intended 'Skye as MCP server' shape and guards the not-yet-existing gateway entry point. Independent of the other FEATs (shares the one worktree; runs sequentially). Read .agents/tasks/example-coverage/context.json and this file FIRST; exact signatures are in the plan Digest.
steps: Create examples/guard/safety_filters.py (Live, Port-level). Implement skye.base.interfaces.safety.SafetyFilterInterface (validate_input/validate_output(content)->SafetyResult, get_policies()->list[str]) with a simple blocked-words filter; run one safe input (is_safe True) and one unsafe input, printing the SafetyResult.violations. Do NOT print any FAILURE_MARKER substring for the unsafe case; phrase it as a normal verdict line.

Create examples/policy/authorizer.py (Live, Port-level). Implement skye.base.interfaces.authorizer.AuthorizerInterface.authorize(principal, action, resource)->Decision returning Decision.PERMIT / Decision.FORBID from a tiny rule set; show one permit and one forbid.

Create examples/observe/telemetry.py (Live, Port-level). Implement skye.base.interfaces.observer.ObserverInterface (log_event(EventType, dict), record_metric(name, value, tags=None), start_trace(name, metadata=None)->str, end_trace(trace_id, metadata=None)) that collects into lists; drive it through a MODEL_INVOKE_START/END pair using the EventType enum and print the collected events/metrics.

Create examples/observe/custom_exporter.py (Live, Port-level). Implement skye.base.interfaces.event_handler.EventHandlerInterface as a custom exporter (all 8 hooks) that appends to an export buffer; fire on_model_invoke_start/end and on_capability_invoke_start/end and print what was exported.

Create examples/gateway/mcp_server.py (proposed-interface, guarded). Top docstring: targets the planned gateway 'Skye as an MCP server' API (R44-48), not yet in src. Build the intended shape from real parts: a CapabilityRegistry of a couple of @capability functions plus a user AuthorizerInterface consulted before each list and each call (print permit/forbid per operation). Guard-return before any not-yet-existing gateway entry point; do not invent a server API.
Run black and fix ruff on examples/guard, examples/policy, examples/observe and examples/gateway so all are clean.
acceptance_criteria: uv run pytest tests/examples -q -k 'guard or policy or observe or gateway' passes
uv run ruff check examples/guard examples/policy examples/observe examples/gateway reports no errors
uv run black --check examples/guard examples/policy examples/observe examples/gateway reports nothing to reformat
Each file's docstring records whether it is Live or proposed-interface/guarded
No FAILURE_MARKER on a normal path
verification: uv run pytest tests/examples -q -k 'guard or policy or observe or gateway'
uv run ruff check examples/guard examples/policy examples/observe examples/gateway
uv run black --check examples/guard examples/policy examples/observe examples/gateway
findings: Created 5 files: examples/guard/safety_filters.py (Live, Port-level; BlockedWordsFilter implements SafetyFilterInterface, returns SafetyResult, prints safe/blocked verdicts with no FAILURE_MARKER), examples/policy/authorizer.py (Live; RuleSetAuthorizer implements AuthorizerInterface.authorize -> Decision, one permit + one forbid), examples/observe/telemetry.py (Live; InMemoryObserver implements ObserverInterface, driven through a MODEL_INVOKE_START/END pair plus a metric and a trace), examples/observe/custom_exporter.py (Live; BufferingExporter implements all 8 EventHandlerInterface hooks, fires model+capability invoke start/end), examples/gateway/mcp_server.py (proposed-interface, guarded; composes a non-singleton CapabilityRegistry of two @capability funcs with a user ClientAuthorizer consulted per list/call, then guard-returns before the not-yet-existing gateway serve API). Live-vs-guarded: 4 Live (Port-level), 1 proposed-interface/guarded. gateway uses CapabilityRegistry(capabilities=..., auto_search=False) (fresh instance, not the singleton) so it does not collide across scripts; execute() is called with per-capability args (echo requires text) not {}. Verification on 2025 HEAD: `uv run pytest tests/examples -q -k 'guard or policy or observe or gateway'` -> 10 passed, 119 deselected; `uv run ruff check` and `uv run black --check` on the 4 new dirs both clean. NOTE: README.md was intentionally NOT updated (plan step 11 is a separate task step and FEAT-004 scope is exactly the 5 listed files); whole-tree ruff/black on examples/ still fail on pre-existing out-of-scope files and must not be touched.
